title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 show captured with clear, clean sound – Birdsong and Loser shine while the recording is crisp and well‑balanced.
ai_review.review: The concert is described as a fantastic, high‑energy performance with no flubs, tight vocals and “balls‑out” playing throughout. Reviewers especially praise the crystal‑clear mix on songs like Birdsong, Loser, Minglewood and the China > Rider sequence, noting the minimal processing that lets the guitars breathe. The recording is lauded for its clarity and balance despite being taken in a large hall with a massive sound system.

ai_rating.rationale: All three detailed reviews are enthusiastic about the musical performance and highlight excellent sound clarity; the show is rated as outstanding while the recording is described as clear and well‑balanced.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note a very clean, crisp mix with minimal signal processing, allowing each instrument to be heard clearly; no major dropouts or noise are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid opening with Alabama > Good Shepherd; the first set builds into a superb Birdsong, followed by a hot second set featuring Loser, Minglewood, and a seamless China > Rider transition. The show maintains momentum through to the finale.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for clean, unprocessed tone and long, soaring lead lines on Birdsong and other jams; described as “flashing those looooonnnng lead lines”.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for a big intro during The Other One, adding power to the jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned for a nice vocal mix with Jerry on Birdsong and strong overall vocal performance.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland highlighted for superb harmony backing on Minglewood and making the tune shine; his playing is described as “hot strutting”.
